$comment: What is enforced (machine-checked) vs. what is convention (a rule stated but not currently mechanically verified) for token usage in generated PageSpecs.

enforced.description: A PageSpec node's color/token references must be one of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json's colorRoles/typeRoles/layoutRoles/radiusRoles/motionRoles keys.
A PageSpec must never carry a literal hex color, an inline style, or a raw Tailwind utility class — only catalog role ids.
enforced.checkedBy: schema/semantic_validate.mjs (pattern check on all string fields)

enforced.description: Every node's motion object must declare a reducedMotionFallback.
Every text-bearing content field obeys the maxWords budget in sections/content-contracts.json.
Every media field's assetRole is one of assets/asset-roles.json's closed roles.

convention.description: Values like 521.47px, 242.52px, 94.94px, 79.8px in tokens.json/primitives.json are measured originals, not typos — never 'tidy' them to a round number.
convention.checkedBy: none — human/reviewer convention only, stated in design-repo/README.md rule 4

convention.description: conversion.cta-band is rendered only as Footer's first child; page components must never render it themselves.
convention.checkedBy: schema/validate-design-repo.mjs (existing internal-shape check #7) — the internal-shape validator enforces this against real source, not the PageSpec layer, since a PageSpec composes sections abstractly and doesn't know Footer's own JSX structure.

convention.description: Any pill CTA with a trailing arrow references the Arrow primitive, never an inline SVG copy.
convention.checkedBy: none at the PageSpec layer — this is a source-code-level convention (design-repo/README.md rule 3), out of scope for a page-composition schema.

versionFieldNote: This file's own "version" is documentation-only, like repositoryVersion/pageSpecVersion in registry.manifest.json — nothing currently diffs it automatically. Only tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's version is cross-checked against registry.manifest.json's allowlistVersion.
